Keywords: heavy, industrial, contractor, roofing, hvac, towing, concrete, demolition, blue collar, rugged, high contrast, masculine
Fits: roofing, HVAC, concrete, paving, demolition, towing, fencing, excavation, welding
Best For: Trades where the buyer wants to see weight, machinery, and a crew that actually shows up.
Do Not Use For: Med spas, salons, therapists, anything where softness is the sell.
Motion: None past a 150ms hover darken. No scroll reveals, no counters.
Section Order: 1. Hero: result headline + phone button, 2. Proof strip: years, license, insurance, area, 3. Services 3-6 with price bands, 4. The work: before and after on the same house, 5. How it works in 3 steps, 6. Reviews with names and neighbourhoods, 7. Service area, 8. Money section: call or request the quote, 9. FAQ, 10. Footer with hours, address, phone
Imagery Direction: Real crew and machine photos, wide shots, hard shadows. No stock handshake, no hard hat on a white background.
Copy Angle: Name the job and the price band in the hero. Sell the finished roof, not the crew.
